title: For all …
titleEn: Using For all + noun phrase for concession

omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: For all + noun phrase, + main clause

formulas.formula: For all + noun phrase, + main clause

example: For all its convenience, online communication can still feel impersonal.
exampleZh: 儘管網上溝通很方便，它仍然可能令人感到缺乏人情味。

examples.en: For all its convenience, online communication can still feel impersonal.
examples.zh: 儘管網上溝通很方便，它仍然可能令人感到缺乏人情味。
examples.highlight: For all its convenience, online communication can still feel impersonal.

rules.zh: 此處的 For all 表示「儘管」 在這個句型中，For all 的意思接近： （儘管他經驗豐富，但他仍然會犯錯。） 它不是指「為了所有……」。 （我為所有朋友買了禮物。） 這裏的 for all my friends 才表示「給所有朋友」。
rules.en: Here For all means “despite”, “in spite of” or “although”, as in For all his experience, he still makes mistakes. It does not mean “for every ...”, as it does in I bought gifts for all my friends.
examples: For all his experience, he still makes mistakes.
I bought gifts for all my friends.

rules.zh: For all 後面必須接名詞短語 不能直接在 For all 後面放完整的主詞加動詞子句。
rules.en: For all must be followed by a noun phrase, not directly by a complete subject-and-verb clause. Write For all his experience, Ben still makes mistakes, not For all he is experienced ....
examples: For all his experience, Ben still makes mistakes.
For all he is experienced, Ben still makes mistakes.

rules.zh: 形容詞通常需要變成名詞 Adjective 形容詞 Noun 名詞 例如：
rules.en: An adjective normally needs to be changed into a noun in this pattern. For example, small becomes small size in For all its small size, the camera takes excellent photographs.
examples: For all its small size, the camera takes excellent photographs.

rules.zh: 使用正確的所有格 常見形式包括： 特別注意： its = 它的
rules.en: Use the correct possessive form. Common patterns include For all my efforts, your experience, his confidence, her patience, its usefulness, our preparation, their differences, Daniel's careful planning, and the evidence. Take particular care that its means “belonging to it”, whereas it's means it is.

rules.zh: 前後必須有真正的讓步或反差 「有才華」通常應該有助她找到工作，但實際結果並非如此，因此形成合理反差。 以下句子則沒有清楚反差： 前後只是重複相近意思，不適合使用這個句型。
rules.en: The two parts must express a genuine concession or contrast. For all her talent, Chloe has not found a full-time job works because talent would normally help her find work, yet the expected result did not occur. For all her talent, Chloe is a talented singer merely repeats a similar idea and has no clear contrast.
examples: For all her talent, Chloe has not found a full-time job.
For all her talent, Chloe is a talented singer.

rules.zh: 開首短語後面要使用逗號
rules.en: Use a comma after the opening For all + noun phrase.
examples: For all the difficulties, the team completed the project.

benefits.zh: 你可以先承認某項真正存在的優點，再指出它的限制，使觀點顯得更全面和公允。
benefits.en: It helps you present a balanced judgement You can recognise a genuine strength or positive point before explaining its limitation.
examples: You can recognise a genuine strength or positive point before explaining its limitation.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚表示：前面的因素雖然重要，卻仍不足以改變後面的結果。
benefits.en: It shows that one factor was not enough to change the result The structure makes it clear that the first fact was important, but it could not prevent the unexpected result.

benefits.zh: 你可以把完整的 although 子句轉成較精簡的名詞短語，將兩個相關意思連接在同一句中。
benefits.en: It can combine two ideas in a compact way Instead of using a complete although-clause, you can often turn the first idea into a shorter noun phrase.

benefits.zh: 它能增加句式變化，避免作文或說話中不斷重複使用 although、even though 或 despite。
benefits.en: It gives you another way to begin a sentence It provides an alternative to repeatedly beginning sentences with although, even though or despite.

benefits.zh: 當你需要評價人物、計劃、產品、制度或情況的優點與限制時，這個句型特別實用。
benefits.en: It is useful for thoughtful evaluations The structure is especially useful when discussing the strengths and weaknesses of a person, plan, product, system or situation.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.
